District Judge F. Dennis Saylor, IV: PRELIMINARY INJUNCTION ORDER POSTPONING EFFECTIVE DATE OF FINAL RULE. (MMM) (Entered: 09/14/2026)

District Judge F. Dennis Saylor, IV: MEMORANDUM AND ORDER ON MOTION FOR PRELIMINARY INJUNCTION. Plaintiffs' motion for APA § 705 relief, a preliminary injunction, or, in the alternative, summary judgment, is GRANTED to the extent that it seeks to postpone the effective date of the Final Rule pursuant to the Administrative Procedure Act, 5 U.S.C. § 705. To the extent that plaintiffs seek vacatur of the Final Rule, summary judgment, or other relief, the motion is DENIED without prejudice to its renewal.(MMM) (Entered: 09/14/2026)
